name: live-chart
title: Live chart
description: Streaming line chart that slides left as new values arrive. You give it a function for the next value; pause it any time.
htmlExample:
<bef-live-chart id="lc" class="w-full max-w-xl" :interval-ms="500" :height="120"></bef-live-chart>
<script>document.getElementById('lc').props = { next: (p) => Math.max(5, Math.min(95, (p || 50) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14)) };</script>
